messages:
devops-bot: alert: embedders-prod error-rate climbed to ~3.2% at 13:12 UTC for v2.3.1. auto-flagged as P2.
sam: saw the spike, root cause looks like tokenizer edge-case w/ empty-batch header. I can ship a minimal hotfix (v2.3.3-rc1) that adds a guardrail. request expedited approval in today's 14:00-15:00 change window.
anya: paste rollback & safety gates pls. want clear metrics to flip the breaker.
sam: rollback gates: 1) canary error-rate >1.5% absolute increase vs baseline for 5m OR 2) p95 latency regresses >120ms sustained 5m OR 3) Sentry new error count >30 in 10m. If any hit -> rollback to v2.3.1. No DB migrations. Impact: embeddings only, downstream retries will handle duplicates.
product-lead: link to short release note for support: https://redwood.in/releases/notes/2.3.3-rc1 — one-liner fine. I approve expedited if SRE + oncall ok. :white_check_mark: 
oncall-sre: i'm on it. current baseline p95=160ms, errors baseline ~0.6%. I'll monitor and trigger rollback if gates tripped.
sam: deployment plan: 1) push image tag ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1; 2) staging smoke 3m; 3) canary 5% for 10m with automated healthchecks; 4) ramp to 25% for 15m; 5) ramp to 100% in two steps (60% ->100%) 5m apart. Will pin image in manifest.
anya: please add a fast rollback button in the runbook + a manual traffic-swap play. also include alert notify @oncall-sre and ops-channel on rollback.
sam: updated runbook gist: https://runbooks.internal/embeds-hotfix-2.3.3. added manual rollback steps and bus-factor owner: sam.
devops-bot: @channel deploy request queued: embeds-prod v2.3.3-rc1 (image: ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1). change window: 14:00-15:00 PDT. staging smoke and canary configured. runbook: /runbooks/embeds-hotfix-2.3.3.
releasebot: note: change window OK. auto-tests green on the build pipeline. security-scan: no findings.
sam: pushing tag now: `docker tag embeds:latest ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1 && docker push ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1`
releasebot: image ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1 pushed by sam at 13:45 UTC.
sam: starting staging smoke: `kubectl -n staging set image deploy/embeds embeds=ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.3-rc1 && kubectl -n staging rollout status deploy/embeds --timeout=120s`
devops-bot: staging smoke: pods 4/4 ready, smoke tests passed (basic embed calls). initiating canary: 5% traffic for 10m.
oncall-sre: canary @14:12: errors 0.7% (within baseline), p95 162ms. no new Sentry issues. continuing monitoring.
anya: +1 from me for ramp based on metrics so far. keep the gates strict.
sam: ramping to 25% now.
devops-bot: canary checks OK. adjusting traffic to 25% (weight update applied). next hold 15m.
oncall-sre: 25% @14:27: errors 0.9%, p95 168ms. small uptick but within allowed. observing logs; I see a couple of bot-traffic spikes but not user-facing.
product-lead: product confirms changelog and support blurb. going to notify CS.
sam: proceeding to 60% -> then 100% per plan.
devops-bot: ramping: 60% now.
oncall-sre: 60% @14:35: errors 1.4% (close to threshold). p95 180ms. starting focused tail-sampling.
anya: if error-rate crosses 1.5% for 5m, we rollback. team, be ready.
sam: holding until 14:38 for one more sample.
oncall-sre: 14:38: error-rate 1.7% sustained 6m, Sentry new errors 42 in 10m -> TRIPPING ROLLBACK GATE.
anya: initiating rollback now.
devops-bot: rollback command triggered by anya: reverting traffic to v2.3.1 and deploying pinned image ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.1. executing.
releasebot: rollback in progress: running `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=ghcr.io/redwood/embeds:2.3.1` and checking health.
oncall-sre: post-rollback metrics (14:44): errors back to 0.8%, p95 165ms. Sentry new errors stopping. all good.
sam: investigating root cause now, adding an additional defensive check and a unit test for the edge case. will open PR for v2.3.3.
product-lead: thanks for fast action. marking this as expedited attempt, aborted due to telemetry. pls add customer note and internal postmortem once root cause tracked.
anya: please include exact timestamps and the metric graphs in the postmortem. put the follow-up PR with more conservative retry/backoff.
sam: will do. reassigning follow-up to sam + anya. closing this deploy request as rolled back.
devops-bot: deploy event: embeds-prod v2.3.3-rc1 rolled back at 14:44 UTC. link: https://deploys.redwood.dev/embeds/1787659999/rollback
